name: dumbbell-pullover.html
instructions:
1. Lie on a bench, with your upper back and shoulders supported, and feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold one dumbbell with both hands, palms pressed together, and arms extended straight above your chest. This is the starting position.
3. Slowly lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Feel a stretch in your chest and lats as the dumbbell lowers.
5. Bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position. This is one rep.
6. Perform the desired reps, focusing on control and muscle engagement.
